title: Read the latest MCP previews across GUI edits and explain stale mutation conflicts
source: rapidroom (original implementation with Codex; existing MCP authorship retained)
notes: Read-only render tools accept an advisory expectedRevision and report the current edit revision. Preview render-recipe identity is separate. Mutation revisions remain strict; conflicts include currentRevision, retained-snapshot changedKeys and the latest history actor, or explicitly unknown changes when the snapshot was evicted. Editor context includes editRevision, appVersion and compiled Git source identity/dirty status. 163 frontend tests, 317 default/349 combined Rust tests and a 15-step Linux native pass with real Claude/Codex calls cover GUI edits between turns, latest advisory reads, structured strict stale-write refusal and unchanged state/history/sidecars. The command listener stays registered across GUI rerenders; a dropped-request regression fails on the old bridge, and eight concurrent native context requests pass during GUI edits. Incremental source-identity tracking is checked against Rust/frontend changes, reversion and a new Git HEAD.
